issues.detail: Hebrew 'יֹשֵׁב בַּשֶּׁבֶת' is a proper name/title (Jashobeam, lit. 'sitting in the seat'), not 'ngồi trên ngai' ('sitting on the throne'). The Vietnamese adds a throne concept not in the Hebrew.
Hebrew 'הָעֶצְנִי' (the Eznite/Hachmonite) is rendered 'người Ê-xnít' — this is a transliteration of a different name; the Hebrew has 'הָעֶצְנִי' (Ha-etsni), not 'Ê-xnít'.

The Vietnamese adds 'người đã giơ ngọn giáo lên' ('lifted up his spear') — the Hebrew has no mention of a spear; it says 'עַל שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת חָלָל בְּפַעַם אֶחָת' ('against eight hundred slain at one time').
